branch: Phase II — climate series (annual, lagged, wind vectors)
purpose: Supply annual/lagged climate features and wind-direction vectors that WorldClim 2.1 base (static 1970-2000 normals, no wind direction) structurally cannot provide.

primary_source.name: NASA POWER (MERRA-2 reanalysis), daily point API
primary_source.native_resolution_measured: 0.5 deg latitude x 0.625 deg longitude (~50-55 km over Ukraine), confirmed empirically by 0.1-deg transects: identical series returned across 4-6 consecutive 0.1-deg steps in lon and 3-5 in lat
primary_source.requested_coordinates: exactly on native cell centres (measured snap offset = 0.0000 deg)
primary_source.period: 2000-01-01 .. 2025-12-31 (9497 days per point, complete, zero -999 fill)
primary_source.request_pattern: 1 request per point covering all 7 variables x 26 years; 3 concurrent workers, exponential backoff on 429/5xx, atomic write via os.replace; 299/299 succeeded, 0 failures

why_not_open_meteo_era5.blocker: free-tier request weight = locations x max(1,nvars/10) x max(1,ndays/14); published limits 10000 calls/day, 5000/hour, 600/minute

measured_cost.0.15deg_3538pts_26yr_7vars: weight 2,399,901 = ~240 days of the daily budget

why_not_open_meteo_era5.empirical_confirmation: hourly cap (5000) exhausted after ~5 requests of 100 points x 1 year x 7 vars during sizing probes; HTTP 429 'Minutely/Hourly API request limit exceeded'
why_not_open_meteo_era5.model_availability_finding: models=era5_land (0.1 deg) returns temperature but NULL for precipitation_sum, wind_direction_10m_dominant and et0_fao_evapotranspiration; only era5_seamless returns all 7, blending ERA5-Land 0.1 deg temperature with ERA5 0.25 deg (~28 km) precipitation/wind. So Open-Meteo could not have delivered 0.1-deg wind direction either.
why_not_open_meteo_era5.decision: user-approved switch to NASA POWER (~50 km) + WorldClim delta-downscaling scaffold

era5_cross_validation_source.note: a real-ERA5 subsample WAS fetched within the free budget, purely to verify the MERRA-2 series
era5_cross_validation_source.sample: 25 of the 299 points, 2016-01-01..2025-12-31, 3653 days, all 7 daily variables, 91325 rows

coarse_grid.construction: MERRA-2 native mesh (0.5 x 0.625 deg) over the grid bbox, retained only where the point is nearest-neighbour to >=1 of the 599126 land cells

grid_assignment.WARNING: information support is ~50 km, NOT 1 km: a median of ~2467 one-km cells share one identical climate value. Never interpret these features as local. Any spatial CV block must be far larger than 50 km or climate features leak across folds.

derived_feature_formulas.gdd_base5: sum over calendar year of max(0, tmean_day - 5.0) [degC-days]
derived_feature_formulas.frost_days: count of days with tmin < 0 over the calendar year
derived_feature_formulas.frost_days_spring: count of days with tmin < 0, months 3-5
derived_feature_formulas.rain_30d_preflower: sum of precip over day-of-year 136..165, i.e. the 30 days before typical H. sosnowskyi flowering ~15 June [mm]
derived_feature_formulas.annual_precip: sum of precip over calendar year [mm]
derived_feature_formulas.tmean_annual / tmean_spring: mean of daily tmean over year / months 3-5 [degC]
derived_feature_formulas.et0_annual: sum of EVPTRNS over calendar year [mm]; ~25% of daily values are legitimately 0 (winter)
derived_feature_formulas.prev_season_<X>: value of X at the SAME point in year t-1 (groupby point_id, shift(1)). Year 2000 is NaN for every lagged column (299 rows) and MUST NOT be imputed.
derived_feature_formulas.anom_<X>: X(t) minus the 2000-2025 mean of X at the same point [same units as X]
derived_feature_formulas.anomz_<X>: (X(t) - point mean) / point std — dimensionless z-score

wind_vector_method.convention: WD10M is the meteorological direction the wind blows FROM; this convention is PRESERVED unchanged in the outputs. A mechanistic dispersal model must invert it (downwind bearing = dir + 180 mod 360).
wind_vector_method.u_component: mean over window of wind_speed_max * sin(radians(wind_dir))
wind_vector_method.v_component: mean over window of wind_speed_max * cos(radians(wind_dir))
wind_vector_method.wind_resultant_dir: degrees(atan2(u_mean, v_mean)) mod 360 — speed-weighted VECTOR mean, not a mean of angles
wind_vector_method.wind_resultant_mag: hypot(u_mean, v_mean) [km/h]; low value = directionally variable
wind_vector_method.wind_sin_mean / wind_cos_mean: unweighted mean of sin/cos of direction — the sin/cos circular encoding
wind_vector_method.wind_constancy: hypot(sin_mean, cos_mean) in [0,1]; 1 = perfectly steady direction

circular_encoding_check.interpretation: vector mean of 359 and 1 deg = 0 deg (=360) with resultant 0.9998, i.e. the two directions are treated as 2 deg apart; the naive arithmetic mean gives 180 deg, the exact opposite direction. Circular encoding is correct.

worldclim_nodata_handling.reason: 22 of 299 coarse points have WorldClim = -9999 (nodata): their ~50 km cell centre falls on water/outside the finer WorldClim land mask. Masked BEFORE computing any correlation (unmasked, r would have been -0.545 for bio_01 — a pure nodata artifact).
worldclim_nodata_handling.offset_fallback: those points receive the spatial median delta/ratio, flagged by offset_imputed=True

delta_downscaling_scaffold.rationale: user-approved: keep WorldClim's fine spatial detail as the LEVEL and add the POWER annual ANOMALY as the year-to-year variation
delta_downscaling_scaffold.intended_application: T_cell(year) ~ worldclim_bio01_at_cell + anom_tmean_annual(point, year); P_cell(year) ~ worldclim_bio12_at_cell * (1 + anom_annual_precip/point_mean). The fine detail is a 1970-2000 normal; only the anomaly is year-specific.

temporal_holdout_note: Every feature for year t is computed from data dated <= 31 Dec of year t; prev_season_* uses only year t-1. For a forecast made at the start of year t, use ONLY prev_season_* columns — the same-year columns are not yet observable.
limitations: Spatial support is ~50 km (MERRA-2 0.5x0.625 deg), coarser than the 3-4.6 km WorldClim rasters and far coarser than the 1 km grid; a median ~2467 one-km cells share one value.
Source is MERRA-2 via NASA POWER, NOT ERA5 as originally planned; the free Open-Meteo tier cannot deliver a 26-year multi-point daily series (measured ~240 days of budget at 0.15 deg).
Cross-validated against real ERA5 on only 25 of 299 points and 10 of 26 years.
Wind direction at ~50 km cannot resolve valley/terrain channelling that governs real local seed transport.
wind_speed_max is a DAILY MAXIMUM, so the speed-weighted vector mean is biased toward gust conditions rather than mean transport; arguably appropriate for dispersal but not a mean-wind climatology.
Flowering date is fixed at ~15 June for all of Ukraine and all years; real phenology shifts with latitude, elevation and year, so rain_30d_preflower is an approximation.
GDD uses mean-temperature accumulation, not single-sine/double-sine methods; no upper cutoff applied.
Lagged columns are NaN for year 2000 by construction and must not be imputed.
22 points lack valid WorldClim values and use a median-imputed downscaling offset (flagged).
Calendar-year aggregation splits the meteorological winter across two rows.
